summary: Integrated, de-duped, value×feasibility-ordered ingest plan for a MAJOR corpus enlargement, synthesizing all 9 domain assessments against the live inventory (track-D-corpus-P9/corpus_inventory.json: 353 docs = 72 STATUTE, 14 EU_SECONDARY, 49 orphaned REGIONAL_MUNICIPAL_PREDPIS, 16 SOFT_LAW, 2 OOP, 200 first-instance civil 'C-docket' CASE_LAW; 24,299 provisions; doc_type shows 0 vyhlaska / 0 narizeni_vlady — the decree layer is wholly absent). The 9 lists proposed ~145 acts with heavy overlap; after de-dup that is 113 NET-NEW acts (105 CZ via esbirka by external_id NUM/YEAR + 8 EU via eurlex CELEX), ~8,512 estimated provisions, 60 of them directly supporting the in-corpus rulings. ZERO proposals collide with acts already ingested (clean net-new). 12 acts were proposed by two domains each and are collapsed to a single ingest with multi-domain cross-tags: 6/2002, 182/1993, 256/2013, 455/1991, 283/2021, 458/2000, 361/2000, 13/1997, 283/1993, 48/1997, 589/1992, 592/1992. Canonical priority per act = the strongest (highest) rating any assessor gave it. Two flagged items (165/2012 placeholder, 38/2004 superseded by 170/2018) were DROPPED per the 'current-not-repealed' discipline; 183/2006 kept as a deliberate transitional crosswalk for 283/2021. Highest leverage at the very front: the constitutional apex (1/1993, 2/1993, 182/1993, 6/2002) — every 'Čl. X Ústavy/Listiny' cite in the 200 rulings and 72 statutes currently dangles — and the three cross-cutting hubs 455/1991 (trade-licensing gateway the entire financial perimeter points back to), 256/2013 (cadastre bridging civil↔administrative property) and the social-contribution stack (589/1992, 592/1992, 48/1997) that the wage-garnishment 'C-docket' needs to compute net/garnishable wages. The local-government statutes (128/2000, 129/2000, 131/2000, 565/1990, 250/2000, 114/1992) are the only way to give the 49 orphaned municipal/regional predpisy a parent — a concrete, verifiable interlink win.

prioritized_ingest.title: Ústava České republiky
prioritized_ingest.why: Apex norm; roots the entire statute tier and resolves hundreds of dangling 'Čl. X Ústavy' cites in the 200 rulings (Art. 95/36/38).

prioritized_ingest.title: Listina základních práv a svobod (Charter)
prioritized_ingest.why: Constitutional-rank bill of rights; the Charter (Čl. 11 property, Čl. 36 fair trial) underpins the 'weaker-party' unfair-clause doctrine the consumer-credit rulings rest on. Extremely high in-degree.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o Ústavním soudu (Constitutional Court Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (procedural+constitutional). Apex remedy node (ústavní stížnost, abstract review); closes the appeals hierarchy above every ingested procedural code and grounds the binding ÚS doctrine the rulings cite.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o soudech a soudcích (Courts & Judges Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (procedural+constitutional). Organic act for the entire ordinary-court system that issues all 200 rulings; grounds court competence/recusal/jurisdiction the judgments invoke. Hub for the procedural cluster.

prioritized_ingest.title: Živnostenský zákon (Trade Licensing Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (civil+commercial). The universal business gateway nearly every sector statute (incl. the ingested financial perimeter) refers back to, and the podnikatel definition the consumer-vs-entrepreneur asymmetry hinges on. Largest single interlink fan-out.

prioritized_ingest.title: Katastrální zákon (Cadastre Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (civil+administrative). Public-register backbone of all real-property rights; bridges Civil Code property (89/2012) and administrative property law, anchors lease/co-ownership/vklad cites in the 'C-docket'.

prioritized_ingest.title: Autorský zákon (Copyright Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Largest private-law satellite outside the Civil Code; grounds copyright-licence/royalty (OSA/Intergram) civil claims and anchors the IP cluster.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o svobodném přístupu k informacím (FOIA)
prioritized_ingest.why: One of the most-litigated administrative acts; info-refusal challenges are a staple of the správní-soudnictví docket; links tightly to 500/2004, 150/2002 and GDPR.

prioritized_ingest.title: Stavební zákon (Building Act, current)
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (administrative+commercial). Current consolidated building/planning code; largest substantive feed into administrative justice; major hub linking procedure, expropriation, EIA, environment, energy, roads, cadastre.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o rozhodčím řízení (Arbitration Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Invalid consumer arbitration clauses are a recurring, decisive issue in the consumer-credit/debt 'C-docket'; arbitral awards as enforceable titles feed exekuce.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o ochraně hospodářské soutěže (Competition Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: The substantive competition code; corpus has only the 4-provision ÚOHS-competence stub 273/1996 but not the act that governs cartels/dominance/mergers — a glaring substantive hole.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o pojistném na sociální zabezpečení
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (labour rated critical over tax's medium). Largest mandatory wage deduction; load-bearing for computing net/garnishable wage in the wage-garnishment 'C-docket'; bridges labour↔tax↔enforcement.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o veřejném zdravotním pojištění
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (labour critical). Universal health-insurance code; mandatory wage deduction needed (with 589/1992, 592/1992) for the net-wage/premium-arrears rulings.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o důchodovém pojištění (Pension Insurance)
prioritized_ingest.why: Core social-insurance branch; high public-query value; underpins pension/disability/contributory-period disputes.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o nemocenském pojištění (Sickness Insurance)
prioritized_ingest.why: Second core insurance branch (sick-pay, maternity/paternity); interfaces with Labour Code §192 wage compensation.

prioritized_ingest.title: Vyhláška o výkonu činnosti bank, spořitelních a úvěrních družstev a obchodníků s CP
prioritized_ingest.why: FIRST implementing decree in a corpus with ZERO decrees; the operative prudential detail 21/1992/87/1995/256/2004 delegate to; every inbound reference currently dangles. Highest-leverage decree.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o místních poplatcích (Local Fees Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Parent statute for the fee ordinances among the 49 orphaned local předpisy; closes the single biggest dangling-parent gap in the fiscal layer.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o veřejných rejstřících PO a FO a evidenci svěřenských fondů
prioritized_ingest.why: Registration statute for the legal persons the Civil Code creates (spolek/nadace/ústav) + trust evidence; unwires the non-profit/foundation branch of 89/2012.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o ochranných známkách (Trademarks Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Second IP pillar; trademark-infringement/unfair-competition civil claims; pairs with 121/2000 to form the IP cluster.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o realitním zprostředkování (Real-Estate Brokerage)
prioritized_ingest.why: Broker-commission/deposit-return consumer disputes (exactly the C-docket); bridges consumer cluster (634/1992, 257/2016) and property cluster (256/2013).

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o odpovědnosti za škodu při výkonu veřejné moci (State Liability)
prioritized_ingest.why: Special-tort regime beside Civil Code damages; high-volume unreasonable-length-of-proceedings claims tried at the corpus's exact court tier; bridges civil↔administrative.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o mezinárodní justiční spolupráci ve věcech trestních
prioritized_ingest.why: Highest-value criminal gap; extradition/EAW/MLA/EU freezing-confiscation; the codes defer cross-border matters to it, closing many dangling references and bridging to the EU layer.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o státním zastupitelství (Public Prosecution)
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (criminal+constitutional). Constitutes the prosecutor (dominus litis of pre-trial); the trestní řád cross-references it throughout; completes the institutional triad with courts and ConCourt.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o Policii ČR (Police Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Principal investigating body; grounds police powers the Procedure Code invokes; supports case-law where lawfulness of police action / evidence admissibility is at issue.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o Rejstříku trestů (Criminal Records Register)
prioritized_ingest.why: Cross-domain hub: the bezúhonnost concept that pervades dozens of ingested licensing acts (banking, capital-markets, insurance distribution, auditors) plus recidivism/expungement under the Criminal Code.

prioritized_ingest.title: Notářský řád (Notarial Code)
prioritized_ingest.why: Source of a major class of enforceable titles (notářský zápis se svolením k vykonatelnosti) feeding exekuce, and probate as a ZŘS proceeding; bridges enforcement, special proceedings, succession.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o advokacii (Advocacy Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Statutory basis for the advokátní tarif driving the cost-award (náklady řízení) ruling present in essentially every contested judgment in the corpus.

prioritized_ingest.title: Stavební zákon (predecessor, transitional)
prioritized_ingest.why: NOT fully repealed; governs proceedings opened pre-mid-2024 that the 2023-24 rulings still cite; without it bare '§...stavebního zákona' mis-resolves. Flag transitional + crosswalk to 283/2021.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o vyvlastnění (Expropriation Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Constitutional-property interface of building/infrastructure law; reviewed in administrative justice; tightly coupled to 283/2021, 13/1997 and Civil Code compensation.

prioritized_ingest.title: Energetický zákon (Energy Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (administrative+commercial). Dominant regulated-industry code (ERÚ); energy-supply debt/termination disputes are exactly the district-court civil docket; bridges public-law and finance.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o ochraně přírody a krajiny (Nature Protection)
prioritized_ingest.why: Most-cited environmental statute and lead act for NGO standing; ALSO the parent for the regional nařízení creating přírodní památky among the 49 orphaned předpisy — concrete interlink.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o pobytu cizinců (Foreign Residence)
prioritized_ingest.why: One of the highest-volume areas of administrative justice (NSS); opens an entire high-volume public-law domain currently absent.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o azylu (Asylum Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: With 326/1999 dominates NSS caseload; core high-frequency 150/2002 subject; links to EU asylum acquis.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o obcích (Municipalities Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Organic law of local self-government; gives the many orphaned OZV among the 49 local předpisy a parent statute — direct interlink win.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o elektronických komunikacích (Telecom)
prioritized_ingest.why: Heavily consumer-facing; telecom-service debt/contract disputes are a staple of the C-docket; links to consumer protection and GDPR.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o pojištění odpovědnosti z provozu vozidla (povinné ručení)
prioritized_ingest.why: One of the most-litigated insurance statutes in civil practice; the rulings cite it with the Civil Code; bridges insurance (277/2009) and civil-liability.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o organizaci a provádění sociálního zabezpečení
prioritized_ingest.why: Procedural backbone of the whole social-security system (ČSSZ/OSSZ competence, claims, appeals); the insurance branches lack their procedure layer without it.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o pojistném na veřejné zdravotní pojištění
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (labour high over tax medium). Completes (with 589/1992) the deduction stack for net/garnishable-wage computation; frequent premium-arrears litigation.

prioritized_ingest.title: Antidiskriminační zákon (Anti-Discrimination Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Substantive basis for equal-treatment/equal-pay claims; flagship rights statute broadening scope beyond finance; cross-refs Labour Code, Employment Act, Civil Code.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o ochraně zaměstnanců při platební neschopnosti zaměstnavatele
prioritized_ingest.why: Bridges labour law and Insolvency (182/2006); directly supports unpaid-wage claims in employer-insolvency scenarios in the wage C-docket.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o rozpočtovém určení daní
prioritized_ingest.why: Fiscal hinge splitting shared taxes between state/regions/municipalities; links the tax cluster to the local-government and public-finance layer.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o Finanční správě ČR
prioritized_ingest.why: Constitutes the tax authorities (GFŘ, finanční úřady) that exercise every power in the Tax Code 280/2009; supplies the institutional 'who' rulings name.

prioritized_ingest.title: Celní zákon (Customs Act, current)
prioritized_ingest.why: Current CZ implementing statute operationalising the EU Union Customs Code; dovetails with VAT-on-import and excise; replaced repealed 13/1993.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o volbách do Parlamentu ČR
prioritized_ingest.why: Principal electoral organic act; electoral disputes reviewed by NSS under 150/2002; links the Parliament chapter to administrative justice.

prioritized_ingest.title: Vyhláška o předkládání výkazů bankami ČNB
prioritized_ingest.why: Reporting decree under 21/1992 + 6/1993; high delegation target; resolves citing-but-missing references into the Banking and ČNB Acts.

prioritized_ingest.title: Vyhláška o předkládání výkazů pojišťovnami ČNB
prioritized_ingest.why: Solvency II national reporting decree under 277/2009; without it the insurance prudential layer is statute-only.

prioritized_ingest.title: Vyhláška o podmínkách činnosti platební instituce / EMI
prioritized_ingest.why: Core implementing decree of 370/2017 Payments Act (capital, safeguarding, PII); resolves the statute's many 'stanoví vyhláška' pointers; links to PSD2.

prioritized_ingest.title: Vyhláška k pravidlům ZISIF
prioritized_ingest.why: Principal implementing decree of 240/2013 ZISIF (704 prov, delegates heavily); depositary duties, fund limits, valuation; resolves AIFMD/UCITS cross-refs.

prioritized_ingest.title: Regulation (EU) 596/2014 (Market Abuse, MAR)
prioritized_ingest.why: Directly-applicable market-abuse regime supervised under 256/2004/15/1998; high-citation EU act currently dangling; links to MiFID II/MiFIR.

prioritized_ingest.title: Regulation (EU) 2017/1129 (Prospectus)
prioritized_ingest.why: 256/2004 ZPKT and 190/2004 Bonds implement/reference it for public offers/admission; resolves dangling prospectus cross-refs.

prioritized_ingest.title: Directive 2009/65/EC (UCITS)
prioritized_ingest.why: 240/2013 ZISIF is the national UCITS transposition yet the directive is absent while AIFMD is present; completes the fund-law transposition layer.

prioritized_ingest.title: Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 (DORA)
prioritized_ingest.why: Directly-applicable since Jan 2025 across every financial statute in the corpus; current high-priority regime the corpus cannot answer at all; references CRR/MiFID/Solvency II/PSD2.

prioritized_ingest.title: Council Directive 2006/112/EC (VAT Directive)
prioritized_ingest.why: Parent instrument of CZ VAT Act 235/2004; nearly every VAT dispute/CJEU reference turns on it; biggest single EU-interlink win on the tax side. Largest EU act (~414 prov).

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o podnikání v cestovním ruchu (Tourism/Package-Travel)
prioritized_ingest.why: Completes the Civil Code package-tour contract; refund/insolvency claims against agencies are a recurring consumer docket.

prioritized_ingest.title: Patentový zákon (Patents/Inventions)
prioritized_ingest.why: Completes the IP satellite; employee-invention compensation links to Labour Code; clusters with 121/2000, 441/2003.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o Vězeňské službě a justiční stráži
prioritized_ingest.why: Constitutes the body executing custody/imprisonment/protective detention; grounds the implementing-body references in the execution acts.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o výkonu vazby (Pre-trial Custody)
prioritized_ingest.why: Governs execution of pre-trial custody; completes execution-of-measures sub-domain; supports detention-conditions review.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o výkonu zabezpečovací detence
prioritized_ingest.why: Execution of protective detention defined by the Criminal Code and deferred here; rounds out protective-measures sub-domain.

prioritized_ingest.title: Vodní zákon (Water Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Core special-administration code; water-permit/offence decisions reviewed in administrative justice; strengthens the environmental sub-graph.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o odpadech (Waste Act, current)
prioritized_ingest.why: Current Waste Act (replaced 185/2001); waste-offence/permit decisions feed administrative justice and přestupky; successor crosswalk for old 185/2001 cites.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o ochraně ovzduší (Air Protection)
prioritized_ingest.why: Emission permits/air-quality enforcement; reviewed under 150/2002; densifies the environmental-enforcement sub-graph.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o posuzování vlivů na ŽP (EIA)
prioritized_ingest.why: Procedural gateway to almost every large permit and a frequent ground of challenge; high interlink-per-provision binding the environmental cluster.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o státním občanství ČR (Citizenship)
prioritized_ingest.why: Completes the residence/citizenship trio; citizenship-grant refusals reviewed under 150/2002.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o krajích (Regions Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Organic law of regional self-government; directly parents the regional nařízení among the 49 orphaned předpisy (Liberecký/Jihomoravský/Plzeňský).

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o pozemních komunikacích (Roads Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (administrative+commercial). Road-authority/special-use decisions reviewed under 150/2002; links expropriation, construction, traffic and the regional silnice nařízení.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o provozu na pozemních komunikacích (Road Traffic)
prioritized_ingest.why: De-duped (administrative+commercial). One of the highest-volume sources of přestupky and accident-damages claims; densifies the offences sub-graph with 250/2016.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o dani silniční (Road Tax)
prioritized_ingest.why: Current (narrowed to HGVs, not repealed); completes the substantive-tax set; clean deterministic link to Tax Code procedure.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o daňovém poradenství a KDP ČR
prioritized_ingest.why: Constitutes the Chamber of Tax Advisers; parallels the ingested Auditors Act; completes the regulated-profession layer of tax.

prioritized_ingest.title: Rozpočtová pravidla (State Budget Rules)
prioritized_ingest.why: Fiscal counterpart of the tax-collection acts; statute behind subsidy-clawback (odvod za porušení rozpočtové kázně) administered under the Tax Code; links to procurement/public-finance.

prioritized_ingest.title: Rozpočtová pravidla územních rozpočtů (Local Budget Rules)
prioritized_ingest.why: Parent fiscal framework for the 49 orphaned local předpisy; with 565/1990 and 243/2000 forms the local-fiscal triangle.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o mediaci (Mediation Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: ADR companion to litigation; court-ordered first meeting (§100 OSŘ); intertwined with civil/family proceedings and limitation rules.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o znalcích (Court Experts Act, current)
prioritized_ingest.why: Current (replaced 36/1967); expert opinions as evidence and znalečné cost awards — common in contested civil matters and enforcement valuations.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o veřejných dražbách (Public Auctions, current)
prioritized_ingest.why: In force 1.1.2025, REPLACING repealed 26/2000 (current-not-repealed discipline); forced public auctions for realising assets in debt enforcement.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o státní sociální podpoře
prioritized_ingest.why: Major non-insurance benefit code (child/parental/housing allowance); benefit-claim/overpayment disputes; broadens welfare scope.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o pomoci v hmotné nouzi
prioritized_ingest.why: Social-safety-net floor; interacts with wage-garnishment (protected subsistence amount) and consumer/enforcement litigation.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o životním a existenčním minimu
prioritized_ingest.why: Defines the subsistence minimum setting the un-garnishable wage portion in exekuce — directly relevant to the wage-garnishment C-docket; unusually high interlink-per-provision.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o sociálních službách
prioritized_ingest.why: Rounds out the social-welfare pillar (care allowance, registration); large body of citizen-facing rules; high standalone scope.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o Veřejném ochránci práv (Ombudsman)
prioritized_ingest.why: Foundational rights-protection institution; interlocks with the Charter and the anti-discrimination act; cheap high-authority node.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o volbě prezidenta republiky
prioritized_ingest.why: Direct presidential-election act; completes elected-institutions set; electoral-dispute review links to ConCourt/NSS.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o volbách do Evropského parlamentu
prioritized_ingest.why: Ties the national constitutional/electoral order to the EU institutional layer already heavily present.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o volbách do zastupitelstev krajů
prioritized_ingest.why: Constitutes the regional bodies that issue the orphaned regional nařízení; foundational for the regional tier already ingested.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o volbách do zastupitelstev obcí
prioritized_ingest.why: Constitutes the municipalities that issue the orphaned OZV; grounds the issuing authority of the many municipal předpisy.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o cenách (Prices Act)
prioritized_ingest.why: Horizontal price regulation cross-cutting energy/telecom/consumer/competition; compact, high-interlink hub.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o významné tržní síle (Significant Market Power)
prioritized_ingest.why: ÚOHS-enforced buyer-power abuse in agri-food (transposes EU UTP Dir 2019/633); bridges competition and agriculture/food.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o potravinách a tabákových výrobcích (Foodstuffs)
prioritized_ingest.why: Core agri-food product-safety/labelling code; anchors the agriculture/food vertical currently absent; links to consumer protection and product regulation.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o technických požadavcích na výrobky (Product Conformity)
prioritized_ingest.why: Horizontal product-safety spine (CE-marking, conformity, surveillance); distinct from the 22/1992 untitled stub already present; cross-cuts consumer/food/trade-licensing.

prioritized_ingest.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1011 (Benchmarks, BMR)
prioritized_ingest.why: 256/2004/15/1998 administer benchmark provision under BMR; currently dangling EU reference; links to MiFID II/MiFIR.

prioritized_ingest.title: Regulation (EU) 2019/2088 (SFDR)
prioritized_ingest.why: Directly-applicable ESG-disclosure regime binding on participants under 256/2004/240/2013/277/2009; fills the sustainable-finance gap.

prioritized_ingest.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 (AMLR single rulebook)
prioritized_ingest.why: Directly-applicable successor to AMLD4 (present, repealed from 2027-07-09); future-proofs the AML domain and shows temporal succession with 253/2008.

prioritized_ingest.title: Vyhláška o žádostech a prokazování odborné způsobilosti/důvěryhodnosti
prioritized_ingest.why: Cross-sector fit-and-proper decree applied under 21/1992/256/2004/277/2009/240/2013 — very high fan-out as four ingested statutes delegate to it.

prioritized_ingest.title: Vyhláška o žádostech podle zákona o platebním styku
prioritized_ingest.why: Licensing/notification decree under 370/2017; complements 7/2018 to complete the payments implementing layer.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o ochraně průmyslových vzorů (Industrial Designs)
prioritized_ingest.why: Completes the registered-IP cluster; design-infringement/unfair-competition civil claims; cheap cluster-completion.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o zeměměřictví (Surveying/Geodesy)
prioritized_ingest.why: Technical companion to the cadastre (geometrický plán); boundary/easement disputes; raises real-property-cluster completeness.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o registrovaném partnerství
prioritized_ingest.why: Family-law satellite not fully absorbed by the Civil Code; ingest CURRENT consolidated text (2024-25 family-law reform). Status/maintenance reach the special-proceedings docket.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o řízení ve věcech soudců, SZ a exekutorů
prioritized_ingest.why: Disciplinary-proceedings act for judges/prosecutors/exekutoři; institutional interlink across the criminal-justice and enforcement layers.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o ochraně zemědělského půdního fondu
prioritized_ingest.why: Land-withdrawal consents that precondition most construction outside built-up areas; fills a recurring gap in permitting chains.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o právu na informace o životním prostředí
prioritized_ingest.why: Lex specialis to 106/1999 for environmental data (Aarhus); high-precision linker between transparency and environmental clusters.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o hlavním městě Praze
prioritized_ingest.why: Completes the self-government trio; parents the Hlavní město Praha nařízení already in corpus.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o základních registrech
prioritized_ingest.why: Backbone of CZ e-government used in every procedure; anchors the data/e-gov layer; links to GDPR and 500/2004.

prioritized_ingest.title: Zákon o právu na digitální služby

staging: STAGE 0 — CONSTITUTIONAL & COURT SPINE (apex first; resolves the most cross-references). Acts: 1/1993, 2/1993, 182/1993, 6/2002, 283/1993, 247/1995. Rationale: the corpus has ZERO constitutional entries, so every 'Čl. X Ústavy/Listiny' cite in 72 statutes + 200 rulings currently dangles and 6/2002 grounds the court that issued every ruling. 182/1993 and 6/2002 and 283/1993 are de-duped single ingests cross-tagged constitutional+procedural/criminal. Gate: classify 1/1993, 2/1993, 110/1998 as CONSTITUTIONAL (above STATUTE) via classify_taxonomy; verify >95% xref precision on inbound 'Ústava/Listina' edges before Stage 1.

STAGE 1 — CIVIL/PRIVATE-LAW + PROCEDURAL HUBS (highest case-law leverage for the consumer-debt C-docket). Acts: 455/1991, 256/2013, 121/2000, 304/2013, 441/2003, 39/2020, 82/1998, 159/1999, 216/1994, 358/1992, 85/1996. Rationale: directly grounds the dangling cites in the 200 consumer/lease/IP rulings and the cost-award/arbitration-clause/enforceable-title machinery; 455/1991 and 256/2013 are de-duped civil+commercial/administrative hubs. Gate >95% xref precision before Stage 2.

STAGE 2 — LABOUR & SOCIAL-SECURITY (closes the net/garnishable-wage computation the C-docket needs). Acts: 589/1992, 48/1997, 155/1995, 187/2006, 582/1991, 592/1992, 198/2009, 118/2000, 110/2006, 117/1995, 111/2006, 108/2006. Rationale: 589/1992, 48/1997, 592/1992 are de-duped labour+tax single ingests (cross-tag both); 110/2006 sets the un-garnishable minimum referenced by 120/2001/99/1963. Gate; flag these premium acts to the id-crosswalk effort so a parallel tax track does not duplicate them.

STAGE 3 — ADMINISTRATIVE: TRANSPARENCY + BUILDING + MIGRATION (largest single scope gap; highest administrative-justice volume). Acts: 106/1999, 283/2021, 183/2006, 184/2006, 326/1999, 325/1999, 186/2013, 13/1997, 361/2000. Rationale: building hub + transparency + the highest-volume NSS migration docket; 283/2021/13/1997/361/2000 de-duped administrative+commercial. Flag 183/2006 transitional and run temporal_complete so the 283/2021 successor crosswalk is correct. Gate.

STAGE 4 — ADMINISTRATIVE: ENVIRONMENT + SELF-GOVERNMENT (anchors the 49 orphaned local předpisy). Acts: 114/1992, 254/2001, 541/2020, 201/2012, 100/2001, 334/1992, 123/1998, 128/2000, 129/2000, 131/2000, 111/2009, 12/2020. Rationale: 128/2000/129/2000/131/2000 + 114/1992 give the orphaned OZV/regional nařízení a parent statute (concrete interlink); environment cluster is internally dense — gate together.

STAGE 5 — TAX & FISCAL INFRASTRUCTURE (closes dangling-parent gaps for local fee ordinances). Acts: 565/1990, 243/2000, 250/2000, 218/2000, 456/2011, 242/2016, 16/1993, 523/1992, 17/2012, 187/2016, 416/2023. Rationale: 565/1990 + 250/2000 + 243/2000 form the local-fiscal triangle anchoring local předpisy; 456/2011/17/2012 supply the tax authorities. Gate.

STAGE 6 — CRIMINAL INSTITUTIONAL/ENFORCEMENT RING. Acts: 104/2013, 273/2008, 269/1994, 555/1992, 293/1993, 129/2008, 7/2002. Rationale: substantive criminal spine already ingested; this completes the institution/execution satellite ring and the EU-cooperation bridge (104/2013). Cross-tag 250/2016/251/2016 with 'criminal'/'quasi-criminal'. Gate.

STAGE 7 — COMMERCIAL & ECONOMIC REGULATION (broadest 'beyond-finance' breadth). Acts: 143/2001, 458/2000, 127/2005, 526/1990, 395/2009, 110/1997, 22/1997, 266/1994, 477/2001, 252/1997. Rationale: fills the substantive competition hole (143/2001) and the regulated-industry/consumer-facing sectors (energy, telecom); 458/2000 de-duped administrative+commercial. Gate.

STAGE 8 — FINANCIAL DECREE LAYER (first decrees ever; densest edges back into already-ingested statutes). Acts: 163/2014, 346/2013, 305/2016, 7/2018, 244/2013, 309/2017, 233/2009, 408/2010, 168/1999. Rationale: the corpus has 0 vyhlaska/0 narizeni_vlady; 163/2014 is the implementing core of three present banking/capital-market statutes with every inbound reference dangling. Home them in a new cz_financial decrees subgroup; re-run resolve_xrefs so vyhláška→zákon edges wire in. 168/1999 supports the insurance case-law. Gate.

STAGE 9 — EU SECONDARY OVERLAY (transposition/applicability crosslinks; eurlex connector, curate _EU_DATES per CELEX). Acts: 32014R0596 (MAR), 32017R1129 (Prospectus), 32009L0065 (UCITS), 32022R2554 (DORA), 32006L0112 (VAT Directive), 32016R1011 (BMR), 32019R2088 (SFDR), 32024R1624 (AMLR). Rationale: resolves the highest-citation dangling EU references out of ZPKT/ZISIF/VAT Act and future-proofs AML; mirrors the existing CZ-act↔EU-directive pairing. Run last so CZ anchors exist to attach to.

STAGE 10 — COMPLETION/LOW-PRIORITY (cluster completeness + foundational/state-identity + special-category employment). Acts: 527/1990, 207/2000, 200/1994, 115/2006, 202/2012, 254/2019, 354/2019, 250/2023, 275/2012, 62/2003, 130/2000, 491/2001, 349/1999, 3/1993, 352/2001, 110/1998, 373/2011, 361/2003, 13/1997(if not in S3). Rationale: low marginal interlink each but completes IP/family/evidence-profession/electoral/symbols/security clusters; 130/2000+491/2001 additionally re-anchor the local předpisy alongside 128/2000-131/2000. Final gate + full resolve_internal + resolve_xrefs + materialize + classify_taxonomy + temporal_complete + cascade_provision_tier.
expected_impact: SCOPE: the system moves from a finance-heavy corpus (51 financial-market acts, only the procedural spine of public/private law) to whole-Czech-legal-environment coverage — adding the constitutional apex (currently 0 entries), the full Civil-Code satellite ring (IP, cadastre, registers, brokerage, state liability), the entire substantive administrative body (building, environment, migration, self-government, energy, telecom, competition), social-security, fiscal infrastructure, the criminal institutional ring, and the first-ever implementing-decree and broadened EU layers. CASE-LAW SUPPORT: of the 113 acts, 60 directly support the 200 first-instance civil rulings — turning today's dangling leaves into resolved edges for exactly the consumer-debt, lease, wage-garnishment, IP-licence and cost-award fact patterns that dominate the docket; the social-contribution + subsistence-minimum acts (589/1992, 592/1992, 48/1997, 110/2006) make net/garnishable-wage computation answerable for the first time. INTERLINK: large measurable gains from (a) the constitutional/court spine resolving hundreds of 'Čl. X Ústavy/Listiny' and court-competence references; (b) the hubs 455/1991, 256/2013, 269/1994 (bezúhonnost) fanning out across the existing financial/consumer/licensing perimeter; (c) the local-government statutes (128/2000, 129/2000, 131/2000, 565/1990, 250/2000, 114/1992) giving all 49 orphaned municipal/regional předpisy a parent for the first time; (d) the decree layer 163/2014/7/2018/244/2013 converting dangling 'stanoví vyhláška' pointers into vyhláška→zákon edges; (e) the EU overlay (MAR, Prospectus, UCITS, DORA, VAT Directive) completing CZ→EU transposition crosslinks. Scale: ~+113 source documents (+32% over today's 353) and ~+8,500 provisions (+35% over today's 24,299), with the per-stage >95% xref-precision gate keeping precision high as breadth grows.
risks: Provision counts are expert/order-of-magnitude estimates, not fetched: no assessor could hit the live e-Sbírka/EUR-Lex endpoint (sandboxed). Run a --dry-run resolve pass per act (HTTP-200 check) before each batch; actual n_provisions returns from ingest_act. Aggregate ~8,512 could swing materially (esp. 32006L0112 ~414, 104/2013 ~340, 283/2021 ~330, 163/2014 ~210).

Temporal/currency hazards on a few acts: 183/2006 is deliberately transitional (not the current code) and must be flagged so it does not mis-resolve bare '§ stavebního zákona'; 115/2006 + Civil-Code family provisions changed in the 2024-25 reform — ingest CURRENT consolidated text then run temporal_complete; 320/2001 (already in corpus) is repealed eff. 2027 by 231/2025; AMLD4 (present) is repealed from 2027-07-09, so 32024R1624 (AMLR) is the forward pair. Two flagged items already DROPPED: 165/2012 (unresolvable placeholder) and 38/2004 (superseded by 170/2018).

Cross-track duplication: 12 acts were proposed by two domains; they are collapsed to single ingests with multi-domain cross-tags (notably 589/1992, 592/1992, 48/1997 on the labour↔tax seam and 256/2013, 455/1991, 458/2000, 13/1997, 361/2000, 283/2021 across civil/admin/commercial). ingest_missing() de-dupes on source_document.external_id so re-runs are safe, BUT the registry entries must live in ONE place with cross-tags — flag to the corpus-merge/id-crosswalk effort so a parallel tax/civil-procedure track does not create duplicate nodes.

Old act numbers that are NOT repealed (141/1961, 582/1991, 589/1992, 358/1992, 527/1990, 2/1991) must not be treated as 'repealed' by the temporal model purely on age — same situation already flagged for 141/1961.

Hierarchy/doc_type classification: esbirka's CzechActSpec uses kind='act' generically, so constitutional-rank instruments (1/1993, 2/1993, 110/1998) and the vyhlášky/nařízení decree layer (163/2014 etc.) need post-ingest classify_taxonomy to sit at the correct tier; EU CELEX additions need a curated valid_from/valid_to row in eurlex _EU_DATES or dates won't parse.

Registry-home churn: cz_domains.py currently has no 'civil'/'private_law', 'constitutional', 'social_security', 'building', 'environment', 'migration', 'self_government', 'commercial_economic' groups, and cz_financial.py has no decrees group — these new PERIMETER keys must be added before ingestion or the batch won't enumerate. Verify connector wiring once per new group.

Gate discipline must hold: a batch that fails the >95% xref-precision gate (e.g. a large act like 104/2013 or 32006L0112 importing many bare '§27'/'Article 27' cites that ground to the wrong statute — a known engine weakness) must be quarantined and not block later independent stages; sequence so dependents (EU overlay Stage 9, decrees Stage 8) come after their CZ anchors exist.
